name: DARTS Regressor
description: Finds a composition of functions and coefficients to minimize a loss function using Differentiable Architecture Search (DARTS).

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: Batch size for the data loader.

parameters.name: num_graph_nodes
parameters.description: Number of nodes in the computation graph.

parameters.name: output_type
parameters.description: Output transformation function type.

parameters.name: classifier_weight_decay
parameters.description: Weight decay for classifier.

parameters.name: darts_type
parameters.description: Type of DARTS algorithm to use ('original' or 'fair').

parameters.name: param_updates_per_epoch
parameters.description: Number of operation parameter updates per epoch.

parameters.name: param_updates_for_sampled_model
parameters.description: Number of parameter updates for final sampled model.

parameters.name: param_learning_rate_max
parameters.description: Initial learning rate for operation parameters.

parameters.name: param_learning_rate_min
parameters.description: Final learning rate for operation parameters.

parameters.name: param_momentum
parameters.description: Momentum coefficient for parameter optimization.

parameters.name: arch_updates_per_epoch
parameters.description: Number of architecture weight updates per epoch.

parameters.name: arch_learning_rate_max
parameters.description: Initial learning rate for architecture weights.

parameters.name: arch_weight_decay
parameters.description: Weight decay for architecture weights.

parameters.name: arch_weight_decay_df
parameters.description: Scaled weight decay based on number of parameters per operation.

parameters.name: arch_weight_decay_base
parameters.description: Base weight decay added to scaled decay.

parameters.name: arch_momentum
parameters.description: Momentum coefficient for architecture weight optimization.

parameters.name: fair_darts_loss_weight
parameters.description: Loss weight forcing architecture weights toward 0 or 1.

parameters.name: max_epochs
parameters.description: Maximum number of training epochs.

parameters.name: grad_clip
parameters.description: Gradient clipping value.

parameters.name: primitives
parameters.description: List of primitive operations to choose from.

parameters.name: train_classifier_coefficients
parameters.description: Whether to train edge contribution coefficients.

parameters.name: train_classifier_bias
parameters.description: Whether to train classifier bias term.

parameters.name: sampling_strategy
parameters.description: Strategy for selecting operations from the graph.
